title: Tables: Sortable, Editable Entity Lists
summary: BeginTable flags, column setup, frozen headers, sorting through an index array with qsort, full-row selection and editable cells for bulk scene editing.

quiz.q: The user clicks the 'Name' header. What is the correct way to sort?
options: Sort an array of entity indices and draw rows through it
quiz.explain: Reordering the real array changes every entity's index and breaks gSelectedEntity and anything else that stores indices. The table is a view: sort an index array.

quiz.q: When should you re-run your sort?
options: When TableGetSortSpecs()->SpecsDirty is true (and when the list itself changes), then set SpecsDirty = false
quiz.explain: SpecsDirty tells you the user changed the sort. Re-sorting every frame makes rows jump while you edit them.

quiz.q: Every row has ImGui::Checkbox("##vis", &e->visible). Clicking row 3's checkbox toggles row 0 instead. What is missing?
quiz.explain: All the checkboxes have the same ID, "##vis". Pushing the entity index makes each row's widgets unique.

quiz.q: You add ImGuiTableFlags_ScrollY and the table collapses or fills the whole window unexpectedly. What does it need?
options: An outer size in BeginTable(id, cols, flags, outer_size)
quiz.explain: A scrolling table is its own child region, so it needs a size. For example, ImVec2(0, -footerHeight) fills the window but leaves room for a footer.
